subject: Payment held: VAT code mismatch on invoices / proposed batching + sweep plan
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@cloudwave-systems.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@cloudwave-systems.com>, treasurer@cloudwave-systems.com
Date: 2026-08-22 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Outstanding invoices / remittance advice attached

Hi Karthik,

Attached is our remittance for payments posted on 2026-08-15. We see two amounts were posted but only one invoice (INV-2048) shows as paid in your statements. The second payment (EUR 9,240) references the PO field rather than the invoice number; bank trace attached. Can you confirm how Redwood will apply that cash? Our AP needs the allocation for our month-end.

Attachments: remittance_advice_20260815.pdf, bank_trace_7789123.pdf

Thanks,
Marta
Marta Lopez
Director, Finance Operations
CloudWave Systems
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@cloudwave-systems.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-22 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Outstanding invoices / remittance advice attached

Hi Marta — thanks for the note and the files. I pulled the statement (attached) and I can see the two separate bank credits. It looks like the second payment arrived with VAT coding that didn’t match our invoice metadata (we expect VAT=0 for INV-2051 but the transfer came through VAT=20% in the bank reference). That mismatch triggered a temporary hold in our collections queue pending AP verification.

Short answer: we can either reapply the cash to INV-2051 after a manual tax reclassification on our side, or we can request CloudWave to reissue a remittance with invoice numbers in the payment reference and a VAT breakdown. Manual reclassification will take 24–48 hours and requires finance ops sign-off.

Proposed immediate action (I suggest option A + a workflow change):
- Option A (fast): Collections will manually reclassify the VAT tag and apply the EUR 9,240 to INV-2051 today (ETA: within 48 hours). Requires approval from Laura.
- Option B (preferred long-term): CloudWave updates future transfers to include invoice numbers in the reference and a VAT line; we will accept batched remittances only when invoice references are present.

Can Laura confirm approval to proceed with manual reclassification? Sean — please note for reconciliation and tax reporting. Vanessa — can you follow up with Marina in Partner Ops to propose billing guidance for CloudWave (virtual-account or structured reference)?

Best,
Karthik
Sr. Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
From: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@cloudwave-systems.com>
Cc: sean.gallagher@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-22 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Outstanding invoices / remittance advice attached

Karthik / Marta — fine to proceed with manual reclassification to avoid CloudWave month-end disruption. Two notes:
1) Collections should record the manual tax adjustment with a short audit note referencing the remittance and bank trace (include both attachments).
2) For tax reporting we need the final mapping documented (invoice -> payment -> VAT rate). Sean, please capture this in the reconciliation ticket (I'll assign).

Marta — thank you for the remittance file. If CloudWave can add the invoice numbers to the payment reference going forward that will reduce manual touches. If you need a sample reference format, see bullet below.

Suggested payment reference format (sample):
- RW-INV-2051|INV-2052|VAT0
or when batching:
- RW-BATCH-20260815|INV-2051,INV-2052|VAT0

Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@cloudwave-systems.com>
To: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@cloudwave-systems.com>, treasurer@cloudwave-systems.com
Date: 2026-08-23 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Outstanding invoices / remittance advice attached

Laura / Karthik — thanks, we can do that. AP will append invoice refs for future transfers and will trial the sample format on the next batch (expected 2026-09-01). For this payment we will also generate a supplemental remittance with the invoice reference and resend — you should receive it shortly.

One question: if Redwood performs the manual VAT reclassification, will you provide CloudWave with an adjusted statement for our records (we need to reconcile the VAT that was reclassified)?

Regards,
Marta
From: sean.gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@cloudwave-systems.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-25 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Outstanding invoices / remittance advice attached

Laura / team / Marta — confirming collections completed the manual reclassification and applied the EUR 9,240 to INV-2051 at 14:30 PDT today. Audit entry created: REC-20260825-1752. I attached the updated statement (statement_Aug2026_CloudWave.pdf) showing INV-2051 as paid and the VAT adjustment note.

Marta — we will upload the adjusted statement to your Drive link and email AP an official PDF copy. Please confirm receipt once you have it and we’ll close the ticket.

Sean Gallagher

Redwood Inference
